claim.claim-text: 1. A composition comprising one or more cytidine diphosphate (CDP)-conjugated precursors selected from the group consisting of CDP-choline, CDP-ethanolamine, CDP-diacylglycerol (CDP-DAG), and combinations thereof for use in a method for treating an acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) in a subject, comprising administering to the subject an effective amount of said composition, wherein CDP-conjugated precursors are the only active ingredient, and wherein the composition is administered after the subject has developed ARDS.

2. A composition comprising one or more cytidine diphosphate (CDP)-conjugated precursors selected from the group consisting of CDP-choline, CDP-ethanolamine, CDP-diacylglycerol (CDP-DAG), and combinations thereof for use in a method for treating an acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) in a subject, comprising administering to the subject an effective amount of said composition, wherein the composition does not comprise a nucleotide, and wherein the composition is administered after the subject has developed ARDS, wherein the composition optionally is a composition of claim 1.
3. The composition for use of any one of claims 1 or 2, wherein an effective amount of the composition is at least 0.1 ng per kg of body weight.

4. The composition for use of any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the composition comprises two or more cytidine diphosphate (CDP)-conjugated precursors selected from the group consisting of CDP-choline, CDP-ethanolamine, and CDP-diacylglycerol (CDP-DAG), in a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier.
5. The composition for use of any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the composition is administered intravenously, orally, or by inhalation.

6. The composition for use of any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the ARDS is caused a direct lung insult, wherein the direct lung insult is selected from the group comprising of a viral, bacterial, or fungal infection; toxic gas inhalation; a lung cancer; chemotherapy; acid aspiration; and chest trauma.
7. The composition for use of claim 6, wherein the infection comprises influenza.
8. The composition for use of any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the ARDS is caused as an indirect result of trauma to other body regions.
9. The composition for use of claim 8, wherein the trauma is selected from the group consisting of sepsis, ischemia/reperfusion, and surgery.
10. The composition for use of any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the composition is administered to the subject prior to infection with one or more influenza virus strains.
11. The composition for use of any one of claims 1 to 10, wherein the composition comprises CDP-diacylglycerol (CDP-DAG).
12. The composition for use of any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein the composition comprises CDP-choline.
13. The composition for use of any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the composition essentially consists of CDP-choline and CDP-DAG in a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier.
14. The composition for use of any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the composition comprises CDP-choline, CDP-DAG, and CDP-ethanolamine.
15. The composition for use of any one of claims 1 to 14, wherein the composition is in a powder or tablet form.
